claims.text: All 4 pore models are pre-normalized (mean ~0, std ~1).
Central base drives k-mer current in every chemistry.
RNA001 5-mer ~ central 5-mer of RNA004 9-mer (Pearson r=0.984, n=1024).
Uncalled4 fastest on every supported chemistry.
Uncalled4 ~67x faster than Nanopolish on DNA r9.4 (39.6 vs 2654 min).
Uncalled4 ~29x faster than f5c on DNA r10.4 (54.4 vs 1573.5 min).
Uncalled4 produces smallest output file in 6/8 supported cells; >=20x smaller than f5c/Nanopolish.
Nanopolish/Tombo do not support DNA r10.4.1 / RNA004.
m6Anet on Uncalled4 alignments: AUROC=0.998, AUPRC=0.993.
m6Anet on Nanopolish alignments: AUROC=0.901, AUPRC=0.778.
Uncalled4-m6Anet best F1 = 0.964 vs Nanopolish-m6Anet best F1 = 0.698.
Uncalled4-m6Anet probabilities better separated and better calibrated than Nanopolish-m6Anet.
